text.zh_CN:
研究笔记里的要素连线令人困惑？练习册可以让你先熟悉要素之间的直接组成关系。手持右键打开练习册，选择一到七级，再从左页选择要素，填入右页的六边形中。
让所有金边要素通过相邻且有直接组成关系的要素连通，就算完成练习。左键填入，右键擦除；鼠标悬停可查看要素组成。
text.en_US:
Research-note connections can be puzzling. The workbook lets you practice the direct relationships between aspects. Use it in your hand, choose a level from I to VII, then select aspects on the left page and place them in the hexes on the right.
Connect every gold-bordered aspect through adjacent aspects with a direct component relationship. Left-click to place, right-click to erase, and hover to inspect components.

text.zh_CN:
可以重置当前题目、查看提示或生成新题。练习不消耗要素点数，也不会解锁研究，适合反复尝试。
一本书、一张纸和一个墨囊无序合成一本练习册。
text.en_US:
Reset the puzzle, ask for a hint, or generate another. Practice consumes no aspect points and unlocks no research, so experiment freely.
Craft a workbook shapelessly from a book, paper and an ink sac.
